column1: table s10: trends in visibility of police foot patrols, year ending march 2007 to march 2020 csew1
Source: Office for National Statistics - Crime Survey for England and Wales

1. A small change to the weighting procedure made in 2019 has been incorporated from the year ending March 2019 and into all historic datasets. The effect of this change will only have a negligible impact on the estimates in this table and therefore not all historic data have been re-calculated using the new weights, except where direct comparisons have been made since January 2019. Years that have been re-calculated using the new weighting procedure are denoted by a 1.
2. The question on visibility of police on foot patrols is only asked of a quarter of the CSEW sample.
3. Those that responded "Don't know" or "Don't wish to answer" have been excluded from this table.
4. Statistically significant change at the 5% level is indicated by an asterisk. For more information on statistical significance, see Chapter 8 of the User Guide.
